name: Ryan DeLaney
biography: In 2010 Ryan moved to Miami Florida. He spent 6 years in the sunny state building his modeling and acting career, attending acting classes and various workshops at the University of Performing Arts of Miami. He also developed an interest in real estate and renting out properties. Ryan resides in Los Angeles California pursuing his passion of acting and related work in the entertainment business. Ryan has hosted over 30 successful live episodes on "Real Talk with Ryan DeLaney" and was awarded 2018 male International Supermodel.
